Package com.javiergs.rtde4j

Class RtdeClient

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.rtde4j.RtdeClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class RtdeClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Blocking Universal Robots RTDE client supporting controller-version queries and a validated, read-only joint/TCP-pose stream. The caller owns the connection. Only one thread may read the socket. Background monitoring owns reads while active. Property-change callbacks execute on the reading thread, not on an event dispatch thread. Use ReconnectingRtdeMonitor for optional retry and session restoration.
Version:
1.0.0 (2026.10.26)

    • readState

      public RobotState readState() throws IOException
      Reads one RTDE sample and converts it to a new mutable robot-state object. Only actual joint positions and actual TCP pose are populated; other model fields remain at their defaults and must not be interpreted as measurements. Like readSample(), this method cannot be used during background monitoring.
      Returns:
      a new robot-state object for the next sample
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading the RTDE stream fails

    • getLatestState

      public RobotState getLatestState()
      Returns a new robot-state object derived from the most recently read sample. Each call creates an independent mutable object; it does not read the socket.
      Returns:
      latest state or null before the first sample

    • pause

      public void pause() throws IOException
      Pauses the active stream and checks the controller acknowledgment.
      Throws:
      IOException - when the controller rejects the pause

    • startMonitoring

      public void startMonitoring()
      Starts a daemon reader that dispatches property-change events on its own thread. The stream must already be started. Call stopMonitoring() before invoking blocking read or protocol operations from another thread.

    • stopMonitoring

      public void stopMonitoring() throws InterruptedException
      Requests background monitoring to stop and waits for the reader to exit. Socket reads have a five-second timeout. This does not pause the robot stream.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if interrupted while waiting for shutdown
